about_the_game:
Mind Faux: The First Compliance is a single player first-person narrative puzzle game designed to challenge your critical thinking, media literacy, and understanding of propaganda. Set in a mysterious and immersive environment, you will solve puzzles and interact with symbolic elements, gradually uncovering your unwitting role in a mysterious plot, leaving you to wonder: Why are you being tasked with these puzzles? And who is watching you through the cameras?


Explore the 3D environment, listening and looking for clues to solve the mystery. You will see messages as you explore. Who are they from? You will hear a voice that guides you along and comments on your progress on the puzzles. They seem helpful, but their motives are not clear. As you try to figure out who to trust, you'll be left to wonder: Is this a Mind Friend or a Mind Faux?



Immersive Gameplay

Our realistic graphics and minimal UI are designed for maximum immersion, allowing you to fully lose yourself in a mysterious world.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 or later (64-Bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5‑3570K | AMD® FX-8350
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 960 | AMD® Radeon™ R9 380 | Intel® Arc™ A380 | (4GB VRAM)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Additional Notes: 30fps 1080p Low Preset Without Upscaling; Laptop and integrated versions of graphics cards may work but are NOT officially supported; Recommended display aspect ratio 16:9; HDD storage

short_description: Mind Faux: The First Compliance is a puzzle game that test your problem solving skills. What is the purpose of these mysterious tests? You try to figure out how to escape a maze of misinformation. Or you can comply with the voice that is guiding you along.
